headline: South Korea Exports Top $1 Trillion for First Time on Surging AI Chip Demand
summary: South Korea's exports surpassed $1 trillion for the first time during the January-October period, driven by a 60.6% year-on-year surge in semiconductor and computer shipments fueled by global AI investments.
why: South Korea is a dominant global exporter of memory chips and technology hardware, making its trade figures a key economic indicator for worldwide semiconductor demand.

impacts.name: South Korea
impacts.why: Exports crossed the historic $1 trillion milestone due to high-end tech demand.
